title: AI Paper Lists - Hugging Face Trending
description: Fetches Hugging Face's Daily Papers feed (huggingface.co/api/daily_papers, which backs the /papers/trending page) and emits one row per paper keyed by arxiv id -- the same schema as ai_papers_github_lists, so the same paper appearing in both a GitHub list and Hugging Face cross-dedups. The ai_papers_new_today feeder reads both sources and surfaces only papers newly appearing in the last 30 days for the AI Paper Diffs alert group. No auth.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# ai_papers_huggingface -- Slice C2 (2026-06-23).
# Fetches Hugging Face's Daily Papers feed (huggingface.co/api/daily_papers,
# which backs the /papers/trending page) and emits the SAME paper-row schema
# as ai_papers_github_lists, keyed by arxiv id so the same paper appearing in
# both a GitHub list AND Hugging Face cross-dedups in the feeder. Written to
# ai_papers/huggingface/; the ai_papers_new_today feeder reads ai_papers/*/*
# so both sources flow into one daily diff. Single _epoch per run. No auth.

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())
discovered_iso = now.isoformat()

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'paper_key', 'title', 'url', 'link_text', 'source_repo', 'source',
    'discovered_iso', '_epoch',
]

rows = []
seen = set()
try:
    resp = requests.get(
        'https://huggingface.co/api/daily_papers',
        params={'limit': 100},
        headers={'User-Agent': 'SpeakesQuery-Ingest', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    items = resp.json()
except Exception:
    items = []
if not isinstance(items, list):
    items = []
for ii in range(len(items)):
    item = items[ii]
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        continue
    paper = item.get('paper', {})
    if not isinstance(paper, dict):
        paper = {}
    pid = (paper.get('id', '') or '').strip()
    title = (item.get('title', '') or paper.get('title', '') or '').strip()
    title = ' '.join(title.split())
    if not pid or not title:
        continue
    key = 'arxiv:' + pid
    if key in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(key)
    if len(title) > 250:
        title = title[0:250]
    rows.append({
        'paper_key': key,
        'title': title,
        'url': 'https://huggingface.co/papers/' + pid,
        'link_text': title[0:100],
        'source_repo': 'huggingface.co/papers',
        'source': 'huggingface',
        'discovered_iso': discovered_iso,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
